scope: Read-only review of Core shared source FIFO commit 28369db94 and intermittent host replay LEAK
sourceQueueReview: No definite regression found in dequeue lock lifetime, cancel/claim ordering, shutdown messages, reaper lock scope, or separation of main/latency receivers. FIFO orders dequeue only, not completion or worker scheduling fairness.
finding: Sibling test processes inherited each other output pipe endpoints at additional descriptors; one endpoint was also inherited by a reader-cli child. Reader test success paths wait_with_output for both CLI processes and join their timeout watcher. No unwaited child success path was found.
open: The sampled inheritance and the LEAK reproduction occurred in separate runs. A same-run endpoint retention interval beyond the leak timeout and the exact nextest/Rust/platform implementation defect remain unproven.
boundary: LEAK concerns output-handle lifecycle and is not evidence of application heap leakage. No production change, runner upgrade or relaxed leak timeout was made.
